_readme: CV content for the homepage, taken from Raffi's LinkedIn (22 Nov 2026). Entries with "draft": true show a DRAFT badge. Testimonials are real LinkedIn recommendations, quoted word for word. Sky entry added from Raffi's CV (24 Nov 2026); Limra rows removed per Dom's feedback, kept only as contractNote.

points: Run the release flow from ticket to production across web, iOS and Android.
Built the automated test suites: Playwright for web, Appium for Android and iOS.
Suites run in GitHub Actions against staging and production three times a week, results straight to Slack.
Release gates: every build is traced to its commit before it is signed off.
Tested Sky Go and Air UI end to end on iOS, Android, PS5, Xbox, Apple TV, web, LG and Samsung TVs and set-top boxes: live, PVR, on-demand and catch-up.
Ad tech testing with Yospace, FreeWheel and AWS MediaTailor: ad delivery, ad decisioning, impressions and tracking.
Go-live and production checks for major releases and big sporting events, with risks reported to product owners and release managers.
From 2023, used Claude AI in CI to generate tests from acceptance criteria, with pass/fail reports and Jira tickets for smoke runs.
Led testing of the Expedia and Hotels.com iPhone and iPad apps, from smoke and regression to end-to-end and UAT, in fast Agile release sprints.
Connectivity, memory, localisation and analytics testing; iOS automation with Cucumber and Frank.
Crash logs for developers through Xcode and Crashlytics; daily bug and progress reports in Jira; worked with offshore teams.
Web application testing, responsible for the majority of large web changes.

testimonials.quote: I worked with Raffi during my time at Virgin, where Raffi was responsible for the majority of large web changes. Raffi was very results focused and takes a great deal of pride in his work happy to go out of his way in order to benefit the project he is working on. I worked closely with Raffi on some projects and it was a pleasure to work alongside him, he certainly helped me develop and am glad we have managed to stay in touch since my departure.
testimonials.name: Neal Scott
testimonials.title: Test Analyst, Legal and General

testimonials.quote: I was fortunate to work with Rafi at Expedia. In simple words he is friendly, proactive, intelligent and hard working individual. He is always very open in suggesting and implementing various solutions, which is very rare quality in the technical space. Rafi is very approachable and keen eye for detail which results in getting the job done. His expertise in areas of testing and alternative views on the results of testing ensured that we took a second look and his knowledge in Mobile domain is a plus and makes him stand out from others. Rafi is a highly experienced and skilled QA / Testing consultant, whose 'can do' attitude really helps when time pressures are high and an excellent Team Player. It was a pleasure working with Rafi and would not hesitate to recommend to any prospective employer, or to work with him in near future.
testimonials.name: Dev Gowtham
testimonials.title: QA Architect and Technical Programme Test Manager
